Hastings Town Court: Your Complete Guide to Local Justice

Welcome to our comprehensive guide to the Hastings Town Court. Whether you're dealing with a traffic ticket, filing a small claim, or seeking information about court services, this guide will help you navigate the local judicial system effectively.

Court Overview and Jurisdiction

Hastings Town Court serves as a vital component of New York State's local justice system, operating within the 4th and 5th Judicial District Departments in Oswego County. The court handles a diverse range of legal matters, including:

  • Criminal proceedings
  • Civil disputes
  • Traffic violations
  • Small claims cases
  • Eviction proceedings

The court's jurisdiction extends throughout the Town of Hastings, providing essential judicial services to local residents and ensuring prompt resolution of legal matters.

Location and Hours of Operation

Physical Location

1134 US-11 Central Square, NY 13036 United States

Court Schedule

The court maintains consistent evening hours to accommodate working professionals:

  • Monday: 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  • Tuesday: 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  • Wednesday: 2:30 AM – 9:00 PM
  • Thursday: 3:00 PM – 9:00 PM
  • Friday through Sunday: Closed

Court Administration and Personnel

Judicial Officers

The court operates under the leadership of four distinguished judges:

  • Judge Allison Pardee
  • Judge Stephanie O'Connell
  • Judge Michael Clark
  • Judge Ronald Myer

Prosecution

Chief Prosecutor Gregory Oaks heads the Oswego County District Attorney's Office, which handles criminal prosecutions. Contact the prosecutor's office at:

  • Phone: 315-668-2382
  • Fax: 315-668-5134

Court Clerks

The court's administrative functions are managed by experienced clerks:

  • Denise Baxter
  • Elizabeth Dunham

Essential Services and Procedures

Court Records Access

The court maintains transparent record-keeping practices. You can search records using:

  • Name
  • Case number
  • Address
  • Phone number
  • Email address

For confidential information, submit a formal request to the Clerk's Office. Access is granted based on relevance and legal requirements.

Payment Options

The court accepts various payment methods for fines and fees:

  1. In-Person Payments
    • Cash
    • Personal checks
    • Credit cards (2.99% service fee applies)
  2. Online Payments
    • Available through the court's payment portal
    • Processing fees may apply
  3. Mail Payments
    • Send certified checks or money orders
    • Include case number and contact information

Marriage License Services

The court coordinates with the Oswego County Health Department for marriage licenses:

  • License fee: $40
  • Certificate copies: $20 each

Required documentation:

  • Government-issued photo ID
  • Birth certificate
  • Previous marriage documentation (if applicable)

Note: Both parties must appear in person to apply.

Specialized Divisions

Traffic Division

For traffic violations, the court provides streamlined processing:

  • Submit pleas promptly (guilty or not-guilty)
  • Pay fines according to schedule
  • Seek legal representation for criminal traffic cases
  • Request extensions when needed

Small Claims Court

For civil disputes up to $30,000:

Filing fees:

  • $15 for claims under $1,000
  • $20 for claims over $1,000

Legal representation is optional but recommended for complex cases.

Contact Information

Main Contact Details

  • Phone: 315-668-2382
  • Email: HastingsTownCourt@nycourts.gov

Clerk's Office

  • Phone: 315-668-2456 Ext 6
  • Email: hastingsclerk@hotmail.com

Court Etiquette and Guidelines

Dress Code

Maintain professional appearance:

  • Business attire recommended
  • No casual wear (shorts, torn clothing)
  • No sleeveless shirts or inappropriate footwear

Courtroom Conduct

  • Arrive 15 minutes early
  • Silence electronic devices
  • Address the judge respectfully
  • Follow staff instructions

Additional Resources

The court provides various support services:

  • Document filing assistance
  • Interpreter services (by request)
  • ADA accommodations
  • Payment plan arrangements

Emergency Procedures

During emergencies or severe weather:

  • Check the court website for closure information
  • Contact the clerk's office for rescheduling
  • Monitor local news for updates

For immediate assistance outside court hours, contact local law enforcement or emergency services.
